growing.note: Revenue was $64.60 billion, up 26% year over year; ad impressions increased 10% and average price per ad increased 14%.

moat.note: Family daily active people averaged 3.64 billion, up 3% year over year, supporting continued platform scale.

management.note: The company disclosed continued AI investment, a capital-return program, and a stated expectation that 2026 operating income excluding the legal charge would exceed 2025.

margins.note: Reported operating margin fell to 20% from 40%, heavily affected by a $9.89 billion legal charge.

cash.note: Operating cash flow was $32.79 billion, free cash flow was negative $2.12 billion, and cash plus marketable securities totaled $82.45 billion.

risk.note: The company disclosed a legal agreement involving payments of up to approximately $18.59 billion and continuing regulatory, privacy, competition, and AI-investment risks.
